meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank loans by the interest rate they carry, in one-point bands from below 5% to 13% and above, every quarter since March 2021
meta.note: RBI BSR-1 quarterly (DBIE 948), outstanding credit of scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs, as at the end of each quarter (dated to that month). Amounts and limits in ₹ lakh crore; accounts in lakh. Bands are the interest rate on each outstanding loan. Bills purchased and discounted carry no rate and are shown apart.
